description: Extends the org preset (github>hyperi-io/renovate-config) like every other DFE consumer. Local-only: ignoreDeps (clickhouse pinned to the fork via [patch.crates-io]; reqwest held on 0.12 because 0.13 drops the rustls-tls-native-roots feature the GeoIP download uses; cel on scalo's range because cel::Program crosses that boundary, so it moves only with scalo), commitMessageAction lowercase (hyperi-ci commit-lint requires the description to start lowercase; renovate's default 'Update' fails it), and a ClickHouse server ceiling at the deployed version.

packageRules.description: ClickHouse server never runs ahead of the one dfe-infra deploys (versions.yaml services.clickhouse-version, 26.3.42.3). The test container, the dev compose and the PGO workload all pin it, so a newer tag would test and profile a server production does not run. The org preset only holds the 26.3 LTS line, so without this Renovate proposes the newest 26.3 patch. Raise the ceiling in step with dfe-infra. allowedVersions falls back to semver for a four-part tag, so the fourth part is ignored.
